refusals.fix: Use one of the methods declared for this path.

refusals.description: The request action is not declared for this method and path.
refusals.fix: Send a declared action literal, or omit action when the route has none.

refusals.description: This method and path declare named actions and the request did not name one.
refusals.fix: Send body.action as one of the declared action literals.

refusals.description: The request body is not valid JSON.
refusals.fix: Send a JSON object body with the declared fields.

refusals.description: One or more declared input fields failed structural checks.
refusals.fix: Correct every named input fault and retry once.

refusals.description: The request did not present a usable credential.
refusals.fix: Send the configured service token as Authorization Bearer, or a browser session cookie.

refusals.description: The presented credential was not accepted.
refusals.fix: Use a configured token or session; do not guess identities in the body.

refusals.description: The authenticated principal lacks this route scope.
refusals.fix: Use a grant that lists this scope, or call a route in the granted scopes.

refusals.description: The write ran and readback did not confirm the persisted record.
refusals.fix: Do not retry this write; read the record and reconcile before any further call.

refusals.description: The handler result did not match the declared output schema.
refusals.fix: Return only declared fields that satisfy the output schema.

refusals.description: The handler result included fields the output schema does not declare.
refusals.fix: Return exactly the declared output fields.

refusals.description: The handler failed without a named route fault.
refusals.fix: Retry only after an operator inspects the server; do not send secrets to diagnose.

refusals.description: The HTTP client refused to follow a redirect while holding a bearer token.
refusals.fix: Call the https origin that serves the API; do not use a redirecting base URL.

operations.summary: Read a compact current set or one immutable conversation anchor, then detail on demand.
